body: Register row B-28 (docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md): app/android/app/build.gradle.kts 42-69 signs BOTH the release and debug build types with the Android debug key when key.properties is missing, silently; no checkout has that file and there is no release.yml, so every APK so far carries a laptop's debug key (docs/06 section 7 says 'built by hand with the signing key', docs/12 says it is the debug key: they disagree). When this item is built: the release build must FAIL without the key (only debug may use the debug key), the release workflow signs from a secret, and `apksigner verify --print-certs` is its last step. As it stands the fallback is a stop-gap with no removal trigger.
